en: So what can you expect from this course?
Well, as mentioned, it is a course for
developers teaching you how to efficiently
use AI as a developer. It's not a no-code
course. It's not about teaching you how to
use only AI for writing code. Instead, it's
all about combining your programming
knowledge with AI tools. And therefore, in
this course, We're almost done getting

GitHub Copilot and the essential features

Before thereafter, we'll explore Cursor, an
AI-first IDE. So a code editor with AI tools
deeply integrated into it. Really amazing.

in that section. That section.

explore how we can use
non-coding-focused tools like ChatGPT, which
can also generate code but which can also do
other things as a developer in certain

such tools instead of
editor-integrated tools like GitHub Copilot

And then we'll also build a demo project so
that you can see all these different tools
